title: Praxis Special Education: Teaching Students with Intellectual Disabilities (5322) - 200 Source Questions + 300 Independent Practice Questions
description: Contains 200 original source questions, 300 assistant-authored independent practice questions, and 0 source-derived guided-review activities. The assistant audit found 476 distinct independent content kernels. Two 100-item diagnostics, an exact-blueprint 120-item simulation, detailed feedback, native learning support, and case-study decision practice for preschool-through-grade-12 ID specialists.
contentReview: Assistant audit completed: 500 independent-practice items contain 476 distinct content kernels and 24 parallel variants under the normalized test. 0 additional activities are guided reasoning transformations, not independent exam questions. The 500-distinct-question target is not met.
simulationLabel: 120-question Teaching Students with Intellectual Disabilities simulation
officialCaseStudyNote: The official exam includes some selected-response questions based on an approximately 500-word case study.
disclaimer: Independent preparation material, not affiliated with or endorsed by ETS or AAIDD. Results are not official forms, scaled scores, pass predictions, licenses, diagnoses, eligibility, placement, adaptive-behavior determinations, medical or legal advice, or substitutes for individualized assessment and current requirements.
